label: Every actual root gives being at w to each being it grounds that exists at w
paraphrase: OPEN bridge (b1), analyst formulation, unattributed: every actual root n of the selected grounding relation G at w gives being (GivesTo) at w to each being x that n grounds at w and that exists at w. The local G-to-giving bridge at the root (rigor contract 5 of #1926; #1626): grounding by the root read as productive dependence for being (the sustaining cause-of-being sense of 88a8fba7). Restricted to roots and to w, the weakest form arguments N2 and N3 use. Classical theism (conservation) and Avicenna's emanation both accept it; it fails if G is read as non-productive dependence (a singleton on its member).
